svg.title: How the work was fragmented before Arnie OS
svg.desc: Diagram of my work before Arnie OS. Information sat in many places, and some of it never reached me: Slack channels, white papers and articles, Mixpanel, Tableau, Productboard, Dovetail, Miro boards, Google Docs, meeting notes, Culture Amp, and folders and websites. I gathered, checked and tailored it all by hand. That fed PRDs, reporting, market and customer insights, team one-to-ones and goals, meeting preparation, and ad-hoc research. Some insights were missed. Prototypes waited for engineers, and ad-hoc research was delayed by the meeting load.
svg.text: Information that never made it across
